source: H. S. Ansell, A. A. Tomlinson, N. K. Wilkin, Transitions between phyllotactic lattice states in curved geometries, Scientific Reports10,17411 (2020), DOI10.1038/s41598-020-74158-x
depth: Abstract, introduction, System model and conclusions read from primary full text.
facts: The work numerically studies repulsive vortex particles on a conical frustum and a horn, including transitions and defect structures.
It specifies a pairwise modified-Bessel K0 interaction along surface geodesics and uses molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo.
This is physical energy/defect modeling, not an exact-radius spiral visibility or Chabauty theorem.
comparison_inference: Our five packages do not establish a lower physical energy, an observed mechanism, experimental validation, or an improved cone-packing phase diagram against such physical literature. They are mathematical refinements; no major physics contribution is demonstrated.
limit: This is a concrete physical baseline illustrating the scope mismatch, not an assertion that a 2020 paper is the latest work across all phyllotaxis physics.
